name: Reliquary Vault Ooze

abilities.name: Aberrant Ground
abilities.description: The ground in a 10-foot radius originating from the vault ooze is Difficult Terrain.

abilities.name: Amorphous
abilities.description: The vault ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

abilities.name: Corrosive Form
abilities.description: A creature that touches the vault ooze or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 9 (2d8) acid damage.

abilities.name: Spider Climb
abilities.description: The vault ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The vault ooze makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) acid damage.

actions.name: Sheet Descent (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 (6d8) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, the target is also restrained until the end of its next turn.

condition_immunities: charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, prone, restrained

generation.userConcept: a cathedral-vault ooze that digests reliquaries
